newsitem.title: USA: Suit vs Discovery Zone is class action.
newsitem.headline: Suit vs Discovery Zone is class action.

text.p: A lawsuit against Discovery Zone Inc and certain of its officers and directors has been certified as a class action, attorneys for the plaintiffs said Friday.

The plaintiffs, Robert Kahn and Robert Friedman, allege that the company, the officers and directors engaged in a series of fraudulent acts designed to inflate the company's stock price, the attorneys said in a statement.
A federal court in Chicago certified the suit as a class action on behalf of people who bought Discovery Zone stock between February 17, 1994, and January 17, 1995.
